notes: The native 5paisa feed (MarketFeedV3 and MarketDepthService), not 5paisa XTS. Depth is 5 levels on every exchange; the web refuses a Depth subscribe at any other level (INVALID_DEPTH), and NSE_INDEX and BSE_INDEX stream on N/C and B/C.

Order updates: 5paisa allows one feed connection per token and evicts a second, so both the web and the desktop poll the REST order book (web PollingOrderUpdateAdapter, desktop brokers::common::order_poll::OrderPoller); order_book_polling runs 5paisa's own poller against the corpus's fake order book.
